title: Urothelial organoids originate from mouse cells display differentiation capacity
protocol: Turn the mouse bladder inside-out to expose the urothelial surface.
Digest the urothelium with collagenase P in HBSS at 37 ºC for 20 minutes with gentle shaking.
Inactivate collagenase P using 2 mM EDTA and 50% FBS.
Collect the cell suspension and use a scrapper to extract remaining cells on the urothelium.
Filter the cell suspension through a 70 μm strainer and centrifuge at 1200 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 ºC.
Resuspend the pellet in washing medium and clean twice with Advanced DMEM F12 medium + HEPES + GlutaMAX.
Embed cells in growth factor-reduced, phenol red-free Matrigel.
Plate 20 μL drops of Matrigel-cell suspension onto 6-well plates and allow to settle at 37 ºC, 5% CO₂.
Overlay the Matrigel-cell suspensions with complete medium (Advanced DMEM/F12 + supplements).
Replace the medium every 2-3 days.
Expand cultures at a ratio of 1:4 to 1:6 every 7-10 days as needed for maintenance.
For organoid maintenance, aspirate the medium from wells and wash once with PBS.
Add Cell Recovery Solution to the wells and place plates on ice for 5 minutes.
Collect and transfer Matrigel and cells to a tube for 30 min on ice.
Wash the cell suspension with PBS, then with washing medium.
Centrifuge the suspension at 1200 rpm for 5 min at 4 ºC.
Digest organoids chemically with Dispase II solution at room temperature for 15-20 min in a rotating wheel.
Neutralize the reaction with 2 mM EDTA.
Disrupt organoids mechanically with a 21G needle syringe until no macroscopically floating organoids are observed.
Clean the pellet twice with washing medium.
Embed cells in fresh ice-cold 100% Matrigel and seed in 7 drops of 20 μL each per 6-well plate, then cover with 2 mL CM unless otherwise specified.
Culture NMU-o for the first 7 days in CM.
Reseed NMU-o (without disaggregation) in fresh Matrigel after the initial culture period.
Cultivate NMU-o with either CM or differentiation medium (DM) lacking WNT3A, RSPO-1 conditioned medium, EGF, LY-2157299, and Noggin for the following 7 days.
Remove Matrigel from 7-day cultures using Cell Recovery Solution.
Resuspend organoids in freezing medium (10% DMSO in Advanced DMEM/F12 supplemented with Y-27632).
Store cryovials containing resuspended organoids at -80°C.
Place cryovials in a 37°C water bath to thaw.
Wash contents of the vials twice with Advanced DMEM/F12.
Reseed washed organoids in Matrigel at the required density.
